description: planConflictDecomposition currently selects the first unresolved CONTESTED_BY_RECEIPTS/source_quality branch before qualifying receipts. In a state with multiple contested source-quality parents, a valid completed GUT contamination triage scoped to a later parent is rejected as scope-mismatch against the first parent, so downstream decomposition can depend on branch ordering rather than receipt scope.
risk: valid metabolic diagnosis can be ignored
branch ordering can alter downstream organ routing
multiple simultaneous conflicts are not independently decomposable
arrival/order artifacts can masquerade as a cognitive decision
requiredResolution: Select a contested parent by exact targetRef+clauseRef evidence scope. If receipts target more than one contested parent in one bounded decomposition call, HOLD explicitly instead of choosing by order. Preserve existing single-parent behavior and all provenance/replay containment.
provenance: Derived only from current public repository code structure and synthetic de-identified fixtures. No private Drive names, IDs, URLs, or source text are included.
promotionRule: Do not promote until a dedicated multi-parent unit/adversarial test and existing cross-organ regressions pass in GitHub Actions.
